translations.web: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
translations.bsb: Do not cover up their iniquity or let their sin be blotted out from Your sight, for they have provoked the builders.
translations.kjv: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
translations.asv: and cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee; for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
